about: Real exam parts and diagram labels Exam drill leaves out because the 2025 specification (Leaving Certificate Biology, first exam 2027) doesn't cover them. Exam parts that test no learning outcome at all are left out already; these test one but ask for, or need for full marks, something the specification doesn't name. Keys are the drill's item ids without the chapter: '<question id>:<part index>'.

labels.Lymph vessel: The lymphatic system isn't on the specification.
labels.Lacteal: The lymphatic system isn't on the specification (absorption is 'into the blood: villi').
labels.Body cells: From the lymphatic system diagram (2014 Q3).
labels.Appendix: Not one of the specification's organs of the digestive system.
labels.Macrophage: The specification's white blood cells are monocytes, natural killer cells, B and T lymphocytes.
labels.Arteriole: The specification has arteries, veins and capillaries.
labels.Venule: The specification has arteries, veins and capillaries.
